caption: The drawing depicts a single brown teapot with a domed lid, an ornate spout on the left, and a curved, textured handle on the right. The teapot is rendered in shades of brown, with reflections and highlights in lighter hues to suggest a glossy, ceramic surface. On the front surface of the teapot, there is a raised decorative motif showing a seated figure with flowing drapery, accompanied by a smaller, indeterminate design feature beside it. The teapot sits on a light, plain background with no additional objects or patterns present. The composition is centered, and the entire teapot is visible, facing forward.
title: Stoneware Teapot
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
